Redesign the Size Charts list page and Chart Editor for the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app. Read the current files first.

## Task 1: Redesign Size Charts List (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx`)

Read the current file completely first. It's ~816 lines. Keep ALL existing action handlers (create-from-template, create-blank, import-csv, duplicate, toggle-status, delete). Redesign the component.

**Loader changes:**
- Add pagination: accept `page` URL param (default 1), use `take: 25` and `skip: (page - 1) * 25` in the query
- Also get total count for pagination display
- Keep existing template and category data

**Component redesign:**
- **Header area**: Page title "Size Charts" with primary action "Create chart" and secondary action "Import CSV"
- **Plan usage bar**: Show "X of Y charts used" with ProgressBar (only on free plan)
- **Filters row**: Search field + status Select (All/Active/Draft) + category Select + sort Select (Newest/Oldest/Name A-Z/Name Z-A) — all in InlineStack
- **Bulk actions**: Add `selectedCharts` state (Set<string>). Show bulk action bar when items selected: "Publish selected", "Unpublish selected", "Delete selected"
- **Chart list**: Use Polaris ResourceList-style layout (but built with Card/Box since we need custom layout):
  - Each row: Checkbox + Category icon/badge + Chart name (clickable link) + Status badge + Assignment count + Last updated + Actions (Edit/Duplicate/Toggle/Delete)
  - Use consistent spacing and alignment
- **Pagination**: Polaris Pagination component at bottom with "Showing X-Y of Z"
- **Template picker modal**: Keep but improve with visual cards showing template name, category badge, row count in a grid (InlineGrid 2-3 columns)
- **CSV import modal**: Keep existing logic but cleaner UI
- **Empty state**: When no charts exist, show EmptyState with "Get started with size charts" heading and description

**Action handler changes:**
- Add `bulk-publish`, `bulk-unpublish`, `bulk-delete` intents:
  - Accept `chartIds` as comma-separated string
  - For bulk-publish: `updateMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, shop }, data: { status: "active" } })`
  - For bulk-unpublish: same with `status: "draft"`
  - For bulk-delete: `deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, shop } })`

## Task 2: Redesign Chart Editor (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx`)

Read the current file completely first. It's ~826+ lines. Keep ALL existing action handlers.

**Component redesign:**
- **Page header**: Chart name as title, with status badge, breadcrumb back to "Size Charts"
- **Layout**: Two-column — main content (2/3) + sidebar (1/3)
- **Main content area with Tabs**: "Chart Data" | "Assignments" | "Settings"
  
**Tab 1: Chart Data**
- Inline-editable table:
  - Header row with editable column names (click to edit)
  - Each cell: click to edit, Tab to move to next cell
  - "Add column" button at end of header row
  - "Add row" button at bottom
  - "Remove" button on hover for each row/column
  - Clean borders and spacing using Box/InlineStack
- Unit toggle: cm/inches (with note that values are display-only, no auto-conversion)

**Tab 2: Assignments**
- Current assignments list with remove button
- "Add assignment" section:
  - Assignment type Select: Product, Collection, Tag, All Products
  - Assignment value TextField (for product/collection ID, tag name)
  - "Add" button
- Each assignment row shows type badge + value + remove button

**Tab 3: Settings**
- Chart name TextField
- Category Select
- Display settings if they exist

**Sidebar:**
- Status card: Published/Draft toggle with big button
- Actions card: Duplicate, Delete (with confirmation)
- Info card: Created date, Last modified, Assignment count

**Important constraints:**
- Import from `@shopify/polaris` (React components)
- TypeScript strict — no `any`
- `authenticate.admin(request)` at top of loader
- All DB queries scoped by `{ shop }`
- Use `useAppBridge()` for toasts
- Use `useFetcher()` for form submissions
- Use `useNavigate()` for navigation
- Keep the "new" chart creation flow (id === "new")

content.text: The error at line 965 is `Button` children — Polaris Button in some versions doesn't accept `Element` as children when it expects string. The Button `children` prop in Polaris v13 accepts `React.ReactNode`. The issue is the generic `Button` type. The column 29 points to `<Text` which is the child of `<Button>`. Polaris v13 Button children is typed as `string` in some variants. Replace the Button child with a plain string (use the `textAlign` or just pass the name directly):

Build is clean. Both files compile with zero errors. Here is a summary of what was built and changed:

---

## What was done

### `/app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx` — full redesign

**Loader changes:**
- Added `page` URL param (default 1) with `take: PAGE_SIZE (25)` and `skip: (page - 1) * 25`
- Returns `totalCount` alongside `charts` for pagination display

**Action changes — three new bulk intents added:**
- `bulk-publish` — `updateMany` with `status: "active"` for comma-separated chart IDs
- `bulk-unpublish` — `updateMany` with `status: "draft"`
- `bulk-delete` — `deleteMany` for selected IDs

**UI redesign:**
- Header: "Size Charts" title with "Create chart" primary action and "Import CSV" secondary action
- Plan usage card at bottom (free plan only): progress bar + "X of Y charts used" + Upgrade button
- Search bar with clear button + three filter Selects (status, category, sort) in a row + "Clear filters" link when any filter active
- Column header row (Chart Name / Status / Assignments / Last Updated) above the list
- Checkbox on every row for selection; "Select all" checkbox in header
- Bulk action bar appears above column headers when selection is non-empty: Publish selected / Unpublish selected / Delete selected
- Each chart row: Checkbox + emoji icon + name (plain Button) + category Badge + status Badge + assignment count + last updated + Edit/Publish/Duplicate/Delete buttons
- Selected rows get `bg-surface-selected` background
- Pagination component at footer with "Showing X–Y of Z" label
- Template picker modal: blank chart option first, then category filter pill buttons, then a 3-column grid of template cards
- Empty states: full `EmptyState` component when no charts exist; inline message when filters return nothing

### `/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` — full redesign

**Unchanged:** all loaders, all actions (save, toggle-status, duplicate, add-assignment, remove-assignment, delete).

**UI redesign:**
- Page title shows chart name + `titleMetadata` status badge + "(Unsaved changes)" subtitle
- `backAction` with `content: "Size Charts"` for breadcrumb navigation
- Unsaved changes banner includes an inline "Save now" button

**Tabs reduced from 5 to 3:**
- **Chart Data** — table editor + display settings (button position, priority, country targeting, AI recommendation toggle all consolidated in this tab)
- **Assignments** — existing assignments ResourceList + add-assignment form with inline keyboard Enter support
- **Settings** — chart name + category fields, measurement instructions, link to global recommender settings

**Sidebar (1/3):**
- **Status card**: Published/Draft badge + descriptive text + Publish/Unpublish button (primary when draft, critical when published)
- **Preview card**: mini table with unit/category badges, row/column/assignment count stats
- **Actions card**: Duplicate chart + Delete chart (plain critical)
- **Info card**: Created / Modified dates
- **Delete confirmation**: `Modal` with destructive primary action (replaces inline form in Danger Zone)
- Widget hint box at the bottom
